verdict.rationale: Mangopay's own wallet infrastructure gives a ledger-like structure. Platforms can create unlimited wallets to hold funds, funds are received, held, split and transferred between wallets, payouts are withdrawals from a wallet, and platform fees are collected and wired monthly. This implies per-seller and fee balances, but the evidence never documents balance reporting, end-to-end traceability or reconciliation. Missing for 10: explicit per-seller and fee-account balance views, documented linking of movements from charge through split to payout, reconciliation or settlement reports, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform's money is legible — balances by seller and by my own fee accounts, every movement traceable from charge through split to payout, reconcilable to the penny

citations.quote: Leverage Mangopay's wallet infrastructure to receive, hold, split, and transfer funds
Platforms can create an unlimited number of wallets to hold funds as long as needed.
Your fees are automatically wired to your bank account every month.
A payout is the process of withdrawing funds from a Mangopay wallet in the Mangopay environment to an external bank account opened in the name of the user
